title: 第七章 对雪迪艾兰求爱宣言以及目标第八章 离开古羽镇原因
content_zh:
在颜铁龙他们姆鲁兽车队经过二个小时行走，终于看到眼前像小型要塞的小镇大门。
当进入古羽小镇里面，克米迪斯对雪迪爱兰美女冒险者以及她的侄女拿出剩余的佣金和证明他们完成任务的二张信件说道：“我在这里代表商队十分感谢你们这一次护卫任务。
这信件是证明你们这一次任务良好完成任务的证明，你们可以在古羽镇的绿羽茜酒馆，剑与盾酒馆和玫瑰金红酒馆，这三大酒店领取你们良好完成任务信誉积分，希望我们下一次还有合作的机会。”。
雪迪艾兰和她的侄女接过佣金以及信件对克米迪行冒险者感谢行礼道：“克米迪斯阁下，感谢您一路照顾，希望下次能再有合作的机会。”。
克米迪斯对雪迪艾兰回礼，然后对商队最后说道：“解散回家！”。
“雪迪艾兰小姐，请等一下！”雪迪艾兰正准备带自己的侄女离开就听到颜铁龙喊住她的声音。
“颜铁龙阁下，请问你有什么事吗？”雪迪艾兰看着眼前拉住她们去路的颜铁龙询问道。
“这个～，我～！”颜铁龙看着让自己心动的女孩到嘴边的话，开始犹豫起来。
“颜铁龙阁下，要是您没有什么事，那么我们先告辞了。”雪迪艾兰看着颜铁龙犹犹豫豫的样子就直接说道。
“雪迪艾兰小姐，请给我一点时间，我一定能成为您心目中的英雄！”颜铁龙听到心目中让自己心动的女人要走就鼓舞勇气大声喊道。
然后颜铁龙不管被他这种方法求爱震惊的雪迪艾兰她们二人，以及目瞪口呆的克米迪斯和铂鹰旗他们头也不回的向绿羽茜酒馆方向走去。
“铁龙不要走这么快，等等我们！”克米迪斯回过神上了姆鲁兽车对前面的颜铁龙喊道。
“克米迪斯大叔等等我！”铂鹰旗南向雪迪艾兰行礼上了他的姆鲁兽车对不管他的克米迪斯喊道。
“兰姨，那个粗鲁的家伙居然敢在你面前说这样的大话，真是不知天高地厚！”穿着骑士铠甲年轻人《女》做出不满的动作说道，但是在隐藏头盔下脸部表情那是对自己小姨羡慕之情。
雪迪艾兰看了看自己的侄女，突然严肃的说道：“狮特，你要记住那位颜铁龙他在这种地方大声对我的爱意，那他一定会以我心中的英雄目标而付出行动，强然我不知道他能不能成为王国的英雄，但是我不许你在贬义的词汇称呼他。”。
穿着骑士铠甲年轻人《女》明显被自己的兰姨严肃的所说的话吓到，不过她还是弱弱的问道：“那，那颜铁龙那个粗鲁的家伙真的成为王国的英雄，兰姨你真的要嫁给他吗？”。
雪迪爱兰听到自己侄女的话神情微笑道：“呵呵，我先前说过，我对不成熟少年不敢兴趣，而且颜铁龙阁下就算成为王国英雄，但是他也成不了我心目中的英雄，因为我心中已经有一位了。”。
穿着骑士铠甲年轻人《女》听到自己兰姨的话，吃惊一连串问道：“兰，兰姨您心目中英雄是谁，那个人我认不认识？”。
雪迪艾兰对自己侄女咋了咋眼微笑秘密说道：“呵呵，这可是我的秘密，我可不会告诉你的！”。
如果让颜铁龙看到雪迪艾兰现在可爱的表情一定会狼嚎。

而颜铁龙那边克米迪斯赶着姆鲁兽车来到颜铁龙身边问道：“铁龙，你刚刚说的是真的吗，你要成为贵族以及国家的英雄吗？”。
“恩！”颜铁龙停下脚步对克米迪斯认真严肃点头承认道。
“铁龙，你知不知道成为贵族对我们平民来说是一件十分困难的事，更何况是国家承认的英雄。
而且你不是说要组织雇佣兵团吗！你真的有这个精力吗？”克米迪斯一连串说道。
“呵呵，克米迪斯大叔组织雇佣兵团跟成为王国英雄又没有冲突，说不定以后我真的成为王国英雄呢，到那时克米迪斯大叔你可不能吃惊掉了下巴才好。”颜铁龙自信对克米迪斯说道。
“呵呵，如果真的有那一天，我一定不会吃惊掉了下巴，我反而会让所有人都知道王国的英雄是我教育出来的，到时候你想想看我的酒馆有多么热闹？”克米迪斯听到颜铁龙自信的话就笑着说道。
“呵呵，克米迪斯大叔一定会有那一天。”颜铁龙笑着说道。
“对了，克米迪斯大叔，不知道是不是我的错觉，我感觉小镇的大家都很奇怪，可是我也说不出，到底是什么地方奇怪。”颜铁龙突然对姆鲁兽车上的克米迪斯问道。
“恩～！铁龙你可能二年没有在古羽镇了，这里的变化让你有点不适应吧。”克米迪斯看了看颜铁龙敷衍道。
“克米迪斯大叔强然我不在古羽镇二年了，的确有很多人不认识，但是小镇居民现在给我的感觉很奇怪，没有以前那种重生后轻松向上的感觉。”颜铁龙皱着眉头说道。
content_en:
After Yan Tielong and his team of Mulu beasts walked for two hours, they finally saw the gate of the town that looked like a small fortress in front of them.
When entering the town of Guyu, Kermitis said to the beautiful adventurer Xuedi Ailan and her niece the remaining commission and two letters proving that they had completed the mission: "On behalf of the caravan, I am here to thank you very much for this escort mission.
This letter is proof that you have completed the mission well this time. You can collect your reputation points for completing the mission well at the Green Feather Akane Tavern, Sword and Shield Tavern and Rose Gold Red Tavern in Guyu Town. I hope we will have the opportunity to cooperate next time. ".
Xuedi Alan and her niece received the commission and the letter to express their gratitude to the adventurer of Kemedis and said: "Your Excellency Kemedis, thank you for taking care of me all the way. I hope there will be another opportunity to cooperate next time."
Kemidis returned the greeting to Xuedialan, and then finally said to the caravan: "Disband and go home!".
"Miss Xuedi Ailan, please wait!" Xuedi Ailan was about to take her niece away when she heard Yan Tielong's voice calling her to stop her.
"Your Excellency Yan Tielong, what can I do for you?" Xuedi Ailan asked looking at Yan Tielong who was holding them back.
"This~, I~!" Yan Tielong began to hesitate as he looked at the words of the girl who made his heart beat.
"Your Excellency Yan Tielong, if you have nothing to do, let's take our leave first." Xuedi Ailan said directly after seeing Yan Tielong's hesitation.
"Miss Xuedi Ailan, please give me a little time, I will definitely become a hero in your mind!" Yan Tielong shouted with courage when he heard that the woman he was attracted to was about to leave.
Then Yan Tielong walked toward the Green Feather Akane's Tavern without looking back, regardless of the two of them, Xuedieran and the others, who were shocked by his method of courtship, as well as the dumbfounded Kermidis and Platinum Eagle Flag.
"Tielong, don't walk so fast, wait for us!" Kemidis came back to his senses and got on the Mulu beast cart and shouted to Yan Tielong in front.
"Uncle Kemedis, wait for me!" Platinum Eagle Banner saluted Snow Dialan and got into his Mulu beast cart and shouted to Kemidis who ignored him.
"Aunt Lan, that rude guy actually dared to say such big words in front of you. He is really ignorant!" The young man "Female" wearing knight armor made a dissatisfied gesture and said, but under the hidden helmet, his facial expression showed envy for his aunt.
Xuedi Ailan looked at his niece and suddenly said seriously: "Shi Te, you have to remember that Yan Tielong loudly expressed his love for me in a place like this. Then he will definitely act with the heroic goal in my heart. Although I don't know if he can become a hero of the kingdom, but I don't allow you to call him in derogatory terms."
The young man "Female" wearing knight armor was obviously frightened by what her Aunt Lan said seriously, but she still asked weakly: "Then, that rude guy Yan Tielong has really become the hero of the kingdom. Aunt Lan, do you really want to marry him?".
Xuedi Ailan smiled when she heard her niece's words and said: "Haha, I said before that I am not interested in immature teenagers, and even if Your Excellency Yan Tielong becomes the hero of the kingdom, he cannot become the hero in my heart, because I already have one in my heart."
When the young man wearing knight armor heard what his Aunt Lan said, he was surprised and asked a series of questions: "Lan, Aunt Lan, who is your hero? Do I recognize that person?".
Snowy Ellen smiled secretly at her niece and said: "Haha, this is my secret, I won't tell you!".
If Yan Tielong saw Xuedi Ailan's cute expression now, he would howl like a wolf.
On Yan Tielong's side, Kermitis drove the Mulu beast cart to Yan Tielong and asked: "Tielong, is what you just said true? You want to become a noble and a leader of the country."A hero? ".
"kindness! "Yan Tielong stopped and nodded seriously to Kemedis and admitted.
"Tie Long, do you know that it is very difficult for us civilians to become a noble, let alone a hero recognized by the country.
And didn’t you say you wanted to organize a mercenary group? Do you really have the energy? "Kemidis said in succession.
"Haha, there is no conflict between Uncle Kemidis organizing a mercenary group and becoming a hero of the kingdom. Maybe I will really become a hero of the kingdom in the future. By then, Uncle Kemidis, don't let your jaw drop in surprise. Yan Tielong said confidently to Kemedis.
"Haha, if that day really comes, I won't be surprised and my jaw will drop. Instead, I will let everyone know that I educated the heroes of the kingdom. Do you think how lively my tavern will be then? "Kemidis said with a smile when he heard Yan Tielong's confident words.
"Haha, Uncle Kemedis will definitely have that day. Yan Tielong said with a smile.
"By the way, Uncle Kemedis, I don't know if it's my imagination. I feel that everyone in the town is strange, but I can't tell what is strange. "Yan Tielong suddenly asked Kemidis on the Mulu beast.
"Yeah~! Tielong, you may not have been in Guyu Town for two years. The changes here may make you a little uncomfortable. "Kemidis looked at Yan Tielong and said perfunctorily.
"Uncle Kemidis, I haven't been in Guyu Town for two years. It is true that there are many people I don't know, but the residents of the town give me a strange feeling now. They don't have the same relaxed and upward feeling after rebirth. Yan Tielong said with a frown.
